Key Highlights

  • Over the two-year period, the business generated $1,275,308 in revenue and $510,548 in profit across 50,000 transactions.
  • Revenue in 2024 was $643,089 vs $632,219 in 2023, a +1.7% change year-over-year.
  • Profit in 2024 was $257,258 vs $253,290 in 2023, a +1.6% change year-over-year.
  • Order volume shifted from 24,820 in 2023 to 25,180 in 2024 (+1.5%).
  • The average profit margin across all transactions stands at 40.0%, with 37.5% of transactions receiving a discount.
Strategic Note: The year-over-year trends and discount utilization patterns suggest opportunities to optimize promotional spend. See Section 5 for detailed discount impact analysis.
